expected.insightNarrative:
Expenses Audit is an expense audit dashboard for 2021 compared with 2020: KPI tiles for total expenses, the average claim and the number of claims, each with a monthly line against the prior year, the total by department against the prior year, the top 15 employees by expenses, an expense-type drilldown and a table of duplicate payments. Total expenses for 2021 are £517.1K, down 2.8% on 2020, from 4,955 claims (down 1.8%) averaging £104.35 (up 1.0%). The story is a spend concentrated in three departments and a handful of senior job titles, with May 2020 the busiest month of the two years and June 2021 the quietest, and four employees with duplicate claims.

Key insights
- By department, Training spent the most in 2021 at £66.7K (12.9% of the total), followed by Business Development at £64.3K (12.4%) and Accounting at £61.4K (11.9%); Human Resources and Sales spent the least at £22.2K each (4.3%), with Support at £29.7K (5.7%).
- By job title, Associates account for £89.7K (17.3%), Senior Analysts £86.7K (16.8%) and Senior Associates £76.4K (14.8%), while VPs account for the least at £52.8K (10.2%), Managers £66.4K (12.8%) and Analysts £71.4K (13.8%).
- The top individual spenders are Ruddie Itzhayek with £6.9K, Adela Swepson with £6.7K and Janeczka Ecles with £6.7K (1.3% each); the lowest are Kippar Verbrugge (£2.9K), Eve Nizet (£3.5K) and Marice Baudouin (£3.8K).
- Monthly totals peaked in May 2020 at £50.4K, with 455 claims that month, and were lowest in June 2021 at £36.2K with 356 claims; February 2021 (370 claims) and April 2020 (386) were also low months, and January 2021 was high with 445 claims.
- The average claim was highest in August 2021 (£111.35), September 2020 (£110.97) and May 2020 (£110.71).
- Among expense types, Other is the largest at £106.3K and Consumables - Food & Drink the smallest at £99.1K in 2021.
- Duplicate payments concentrate on three people, Trevar Nollet (£276.9, 31.0%), Granger Tipler (£254.6, 28.5%) and Alford Gentzsch (£143.0, 16.0%); on Senior Associates (59.5%), Analysts (30.4%) and Associates (10.1%); on Business Development (38.6%), Support (31.0%) and Accounting (16.0%); and on two expense types, Home Office Equipment (£487.6, 54.6%) and Mileage (£405.9, 45.4%).

Total Amount Lines
Total expenses of £517.1K for 2021, down 2.8% versus the prior year, with the monthly totals: a high of £50.4K in May 2020 and a low of £36.2K in June 2021.

Average Expense Claim Lines
The average claim is £104.35 for 2021, up 1.0% on the prior year; by month it was highest in August 2021 (£111.35), September 2020 (£110.97) and May 2020 (£110.71).

Total Number of Claims
4,955 claims in 2021, down 1.8% on the prior year; monthly highs of 455 in May 2020 and 445 in January 2021, lows of 356 in June 2021, 370 in February 2021 and 386 in April 2020.

Total Expense by Department (2)
2021 expenses by department against 2020: Training £66.7K, Business Development £64.3K and Accounting £61.4K at the top, then Product Management £53.0K, Marketing £44.5K, Engineering £41.0K, Legal £39.2K, Services £38.5K, Research and Development £34.5K and Support £29.7K, with Sales and Human Resources at £22.2K at the bottom; Accounting, Product Management, Marketing, Support and Sales spent more than in 2020.

Top 15 employees with expenses
Ruddie Itzhayek (£6,861.83 from 62 claims, up £2,243.4 or 48.6% on 2020), Adela Swepson (£6,743.44, 57 claims, down 18.9%) and Janeczka Ecles (£6,668.17, 55 claims, up 15.6%) lead, followed by Dolley Brambill (£6,630.15), Lexy Dagnall (£6,604.97), Davy Knath (£6,390.47, down 31.8%), Herbie Mokes (£6,342.30), Mariele Stivers (£6,292.62, up 47.2%), Rockey Antoniutti (£6,267.71, up 36.5%) and Corine Treneman (£6,256.77); by job title Associates, Senior Analysts and Senior Associates spend the most and VPs the least.

Expense Type Drilldown
Total 2021 expense by type: Other (£106.3K) is the largest, then Home Office Equipment (£104.7K), Mileage (£104.4K) and Travel Costs (£102.6K), with Consumables - Food & Drink (£99.1K) the smallest.

Duplicate Payments Table
Duplicate payments made in 2021: Trevar Nollet (Senior Associate, Support) claimed £138.44 of Mileage twice, 170 days apart; Granger Tipler (Senior Associate, Business Development) £127.32 of Home Office Equipment twice, 187 days apart; Alford Gentzsch (Analyst, Accounting) £71.49 of Home Office Equipment, 183 days apart; and Lexy Dagnall (Analyst, Product Management) £64.49 of Mileage, 256 days apart.
